items.title: Color hardening (C3): does the jade survive a cheap monitor
items.note: BENCH DELIVERED, OWNER MACHINE READINGS PENDING. docs/color-bench/index.html + docs/COLOR_BENCH.md. Six generated ladders (68 specimens) as multiples of each live token delta so 1.00x = CURRENT by construction, plus text ramps with computed ratios and three danger-pair reproductions each with ONE hardened proposal. Globally unique specimen IDs (A04, C1-07, E2-04, D-L02) so a reading survives being read aloud over a phone. IMPECCABLE RUN FOR REAL, two independent assessments: 22/40, 10 findings, 7 fixed including a BLOCKER - the instrument was mislabelling its own steps (unclamped mix fed to ratio() while the hex was clamped, printing impossible ratios up to 71.39:1 against a 21:1 physical ceiling) and a P0 - the bench canvas was --bg #fafbfc, the exact value of the flagship CURRENT specimen, so it had no ground to separate from. Re-verified: 48 rungs, zero arithmetic mismatches, max 8.690:1. Three findings recorded NOT DONE with reasons (composite ratios for the glass ladders, reduced-motion block, sub-13px bench chrome). NEXT: owner readings on a good monitor as control, then the old and cheap machines - those write the thresholds.

items.title: Resolve J2 (COMAR 20.95.01.18.B primary text) and J3 (jurisdiction attribution) before the contradiction page
items.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-17 from primary sources. J2: the Maryland PSC 16-or-more tier DOES carry $100,000 property damage — COMAR 20.95.01.18B(3)(a) quoted verbatim from regs.maryland.gov and law.cornell.edu (both HTTP 200) and independently restated in the PSC own Form-28 packet. Cell B (Cornell mirror) was RIGHT; Cell A (regs.maryland.gov) was WRONG via a mid-clause transcription elision — the cited host DOES contain the figure. The two lower tiers were re-checked and are correct. CITATION VERIFIED: Title 20 PSC > Subtitle 95 TRANSPORTATION > Chapter 20.95.01 General > Reg .18; adopt pinpoint form 20.95.01.18B(3)(a) without the period. TWO STANDING LESSONS: the provenance heuristic (primary host beats mirror) would have picked the WRONG cell, and repairing regulatory cells BY SYMMETRY would have inflated the per-person leg from $75,000 to $100,000 and published a fabricated figure — the tier is genuinely non-monotonic. J3: BOTH-GENERIC. 25/50/25 matches NEITHER state (MD is 30/60/15; VA is 50/100/25 since Jan 1 2025, 30/60/20 before; VA pre-2022 was 25/50/20 — close but PD was $20k). No MD or VA government or broker primary document states $100,000 GL: the Cardinal Care SFY2026 contract has ZERO occurrences of general liability across 1.83M chars. MediRoutes publishes the identical uncited sentence on MD, VA, TX and CA pages (all fetched) and ~10 states total. The contradiction page is UNBLOCKED ON JURISDICTION but must be RE-PREMISED — its original thesis was false in premise since Virginia never stated the figure. P1-B1 and D17 still apply. LARGEST REMAINING GAP: the NEMT-specific provider insurance minimums for MD/VA/DC are still not located, so no page may state one.

TWO SIGNALS: (1) BUILD_ID probe, requesting /_next/static/<diskBuildId>/_buildManifest.js, which asks the server directly whether it is running THIS build (one request, no HTML parsing, nothing to rot when markup changes); (2) CSS-asset probe, parsing the served HTML for its stylesheet href and confirming it resolves - the exact Task #14 signature, which catches a torn build where the BUILD_ID directory survived but assets did not. Either disagreeing is fatal. Nothing UNRESOLVED or merely REPORTED/OWNER-REPORTED is publishable.

SEO targets category queries alongside geo queries. Provider resource pages remain state-specific (providers are local); payer-facing surfaces speak nationally. Owner insight on record: the evaluator searching from New York or California must not scroll past us.

Real photography deferred until real operations exist, then added as truth. The hero receives a new signature animated centerpiece; the current hero is on record as hard to grasp (owner + user feedback). Concept proposed by Claude in P3 as rendered comparisons; owner reacts before build. SafeRide-style flow explanations are built as animation, not video, within this ruling.

decisions.title: P2 technical ratification
decisions.summary: (a) Performance bar adopted as ceiling: <=600KB transfer, <=150KB JS, <=1200ms DCL, <=60 requests on the default profile; P5 measurement may tighten, never loosen. (b) Stripe's decline-don't-degrade rule is standing law for any canvas/GPU work (failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat: true; never render slowly). (c) motion-safe: architecture adopted for V2: motion is switched ON by capability classes, never patched off. (d) The four nexo-motion candidates (nexo-drift, nexo-shape, nexo-settle, nexo-accent-card) approved for P3 exploration and encoding into the nexo-motion skill.

FO-1: C4 OBSERVED on the LIVE production site (main @ f0de3c9) on a Lenovo Yoga 7 class Windows machine with basic dedicated graphics - the route line and the livery van sit at visibly different positions at the same scroll, and in one frame the van renders with no line nearby. Owner also reports a bluish panel cast (C3-class, panel-level; a screenshot cannot capture it, so the colour-bench readings on that machine remain the instrument and are pending). MECHANISM NAMED AND SOURCE-VERIFIED in docs/FIELD_OBSERVATIONS.md - git diff f0de3c9..HEAD on RouteOverlay.tsx is EMPTY, so live V1 and current v2 are identical here. One path string serves two renderers in two coordinate systems: the line as SVG path with pathLength=1 inside viewBox 0 0 geo.w geo.h, the van via CSS offset-path in raw pixels. measure() runs on mount and window.resize ONLY (grep-confirmed: no ResizeObserver, no MutationObserver), so docStart/docSpan go stale. THE SOURCE CORRECTED THE CHAT DIAGNOSIS: the SVG carries preserveAspectRatio=none while the host height is FROZEN inline at geo.h and the width is LIVE at w-full, so the axes scale independently - a live-width change (a scrollbar appearing as document height changes) stretches the path NON-UNIFORMLY, which changes arc-length parameterisation, so the line head (dashoffset on the stretched normalised path) and the van (offset-distance on the raw path) are different points, expressing vertically on a long mostly-vertical route. That is the desync. The frozen height is a SEPARATE failure producing the stale band and the van-with-no-line frame. SCHEDULED: W5, with invariant I20 shipping in the same task per D12. NOT ESTABLISHED: which failure dominates on that machine - needs measurement on the machine, not reasoning from source.
